propositions: The plan-review gate lacks a criterion to assess whether a proposed change is actually needed, allowing over-action results (adds mechanism without establishing necessity).
Bug tickets currently bypass substantive plan review via short-circuit exemption (exempt-PASS with zero LLM calls), producing no review findings.
A new advisory `necessity` criterion must flag plans that fail to motivate or reproduce the change, distinct from asserted-capability by asking whether the plan itself motivates the change.
Bugs must flow through a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only, never blocking) instead of complete exemption, with run_llm=True and coverage.bug_tier stamped.
Both the necessity probe and bug-tier logic must be registered non-orphan in criteria_routing.json and registry.py, auto-monitored by standing recorder, and ship advisory-only (never block).
